stem_book: State whether the following are true or false. (i) The amount of heat evolved or absorbed when one gram of the substance is dissolved in excess of water is called heat of solution. (ii) Whenever an acid is neutralised by a base, the net reaction is H⁺(aq) + OH⁻(aq) → H₂O(l); ΔH = −13.7 kcal (iii) The value −13.7 kcal is constant for all neutralization reaction between strong acid and strong base. (iv) Heat of neutralisation for acetic acid and sodium hydroxide is −13.7 kJ cal. (v) Bond enthalpies of diatomic molecules are equal to the bond enthalpies of dissociation. (vi) Bond formation is always exothermic (vii) Heat of reaction = Σ Bond energies of product − Σ Bond energies of reactants.
